pairDefinition: One pair is two actual matches: A (target Rare battle, Normal X support) and B (Normal X battle, target Rare support). Each scenario is run once with subject on player side and once on CPU side.
limits: Production BattleEngine and CARD_DATA are used for every match.
A and B share identical ownership, opponent, slot-independent common cards, battle/support counts, side assignment and match RNG seed.
Comparison Normal is chosen from the same attribute; three comparator identities are rotated across scenarios.
A/B games share initial RNG seed, but action choices can diverge because the two board states differ.
KO successors use the engine fixed cyclic slot order; this prototype exposes no KO-choice input.
AI policies are heuristic and do not prove optimal play; browser rendering and user-input timing are not simulated.
